newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes mixed in light trading.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes mixed in light trading.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed mixed in a low volume market seeking direction, traders said.
"It was an inside day. There were a lot of orders but not many got filled," a trader said.
Traders said the Costa Rican tender for U.S. rice was factored into the market early this week.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 300 contracts, below the 362 traded Wednesday. There were no rice options traded, compared with 48 traded Wednesday.
Rice futures closed three cents per cwt lower to one higher, with November down three at $10.27.
